name: Telegram account
description: Your own Telegram account for your agents: they read the chats you open to them and, if you turn it on, write for you, each message approved. Read only until you say otherwise.
integration.summary: Your agents read the Telegram chats you open to them; sending only if you allow it
integration.example: What did they write in the family chat today?
signal.message.title: A new Telegram message
catalog.noApp: This build has no Telegram application keys
catalog.revoked: The session was ended from Telegram. Connect again.
http.noApp: This build of Piomio has no Telegram application keys, so signing in is not possible.
http.noPassword: No password is expected now. Start the connection again.
http.notConnected: The Telegram account is not connected.
http.loading: The list of chats is still loading: Telegram is asked slowly so that it does not limit the account. Try again in half a minute.
http.wait: Telegram limits how often an account is asked. Try again in {seconds} s.
http.request.notFound: This request is no longer there.
title: Telegram account
noApp: This build of Piomio has no Telegram application keys, so an account can't be connected. Official releases have them.
locked: The session's key is kept in the encrypted vault. Unlock the vault and the account connects by itself.
intro: Connect your own Telegram account so your agents can read the chats you choose. Nothing is open to them until you open it, and they can't send anything unless you turn sending on.
revoked: This session was ended from Telegram (Settings → Devices). Your choice of chats is kept: connect again to go on.
error: Telegram could not be reached: {detail}. It tries again by itself; you can also connect again.
qr.label: QR code to sign in to Telegram
qr.step2: Go to Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device.
qr.step3: Point the phone at this code.
qr.note: The code changes every half a minute. Telegram will list this session as Piomio in Devices.
password.title: Your account has two-step verification. Enter its password.
password.wrong: That password is not right. Try again.
password.note: It goes to Telegram once and is not kept anywhere. Agents never see it.
connected.note: Telegram lists this session as Piomio in Settings → Devices. Reading marks nothing as read.
mode.title: What agents may do
mode.write.note: Each message waits for your approval.
chats.title: Chats agents may see
chats.note: A chat that is not open does not exist for agents: not in lists, not in search.
chats.find: Find a chat to open or close…
chat.closed.service: always closed: sign-in codes arrive here
chat.closed.saved: closed until you open it by name
exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.none: None. Open or close single chats here, whatever their kind.
exceptions.remove: Back to what its kind says
exceptions.note: "Always closed" wins over everything. Saved Messages opens only by name; Telegram's own service chat never opens.
disconnect.confirm: Disconnect the Telegram account? The session ends in Telegram and its key is deleted here.
disconnect.note: Ends the session in Telegram too.
request.chatAndSend: Open the chat “{name}” to agents and let them send?
request.send: Let agents send messages from your Telegram account?
request.send.note: Each message will still wait for your approval, with the recipient and the text shown.
request.noChat: Your account has no chat named “{name}”.
request.offline: The Telegram account is not connected.
request.done.chatAndSend: Opened to agents: {name}. Sending is on.
request.done.send: Sending is on. Each message waits for your approval.
request.gone: This request is no longer there.
http.locked: The vault is not open: create or unlock it first, the session's key is kept there.
vault.createHint: The session's key is kept encrypted with a passphrase only you know. Pick one (8+ characters) and keep it somewhere safe.
vault.remember: Unlock automatically after restarts (the passphrase is kept on this server)
